This is a standalone archive of all 19 interactive Shinylive apps in *[Elements of Statistical Computation](../compstat_book/index.html)*. Each app runs entirely in your browser: the R code is compiled to WebAssembly and executed locally by [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), so nothing is sent to a server and no R installation is needed.

Pick an app from the table below. Every page also carries the app's full R source and a link back to the section of the book that explains it. The first load of an app takes a few seconds while webR downloads.

| App | Category |
|:----------------------------------------|:------------------|
| [The Inverse CDF Method](app_inverse-cdf.html) | Monte Carlo Methods |
| [Newton-Raphson on the Cauchy Likelihood](app_cauchy-newton.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [ Newton-Raphson for Logistic Regression](app_nr-divergence.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Gradient Descent Algorithms](app_gradient-methods.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Fitting a Gaussian Neural Network by Gradient Methods](app_sgd.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Fitting a Poisson Neural Network by Gradient Methods](app_nn-poisson.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [Nelder–Mead Algorithm](app_nelder-mead.html) | Optimization Algorithms |
| [EM Algorithm for Normal Mixture](app_mixture.html) | EM Algorithms |
| [EM Algorithm for a Bivariate Normal Mixture](app_mixture-bvn.html) | EM Algorithms |
| [Conjugate Bayesian Updating](app_bayes-explorer.html) | Introduction to Bayesian Inference |
| [Computing ML of Normal Data with Unknown Mean: Quadrature vs Laplace](app_ML_unknown_mean.html) | Numerical Quadrature, Laplace Approximation |
| [Marginal Likelihood of Normal Data: Midpoint, Laplace and Gauss–Hermite](app_ML_unknown_mean_sd.html) | Numerical Quadrature |
| [Rejection Sampling for Normal with Laplace Envelope](app_rejection.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Rejection Sampling from a Gamma Density with a Cauchy Envelope](app_gamma-rejection.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [Computing Normal Probability with Adaptive Rejection Sampling](app_ars.html) | Rejection Sampling |
| [The Failure of Importance Sampling](app_missed-mode.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Importance Sampling Missing a Mode: Cauchy-Location Posterior](app_IS_cauchy_modes.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Importance Sampling of a Student-$t$ Interval](app_t-is.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Sorted Importance Weights](app_marlik.html) | Importance Sampling |
| [Hamiltonian Monte Carlo Tuning](app_hmc.html) | Markov Chain Monte Carlo |
